sources.claim: Climate Risk Management Market size: $8.8B in 2026, growing at 32.58% CAGR through 2035; physical risk segment holds 46% market share
AI Climate Modeling Market growing at 26.5% CAGR from 2026 to 2034; North America holds ~40% of global revenue
SEC climate disclosure rule current status 2026: Large Accelerated Filers reporting FY2025 climate risks; ~2,500 companies impacted
EU CSRD Omnibus reform early 2026: reporting threshold raised to 1,000+ employees and €450M net turnover; non-EU companies exempt until 2028
Top climate risk data providers 2026: Jupiter Intelligence, Cervest, MSCI, Verisk/RMS, S&P Sustainable1, ZestyAI, XDI among leaders
ClimateScore Global: sub-5km probabilistic hazard modeling across 6 climate perils (flood, wind, heat, cold, drought, wildfire); 134,000+ assets scored
Physical and financial climate risk 2026: cross-sector ESG disclosure framework requirements and physical risk vs transition risk distinctions
Climate risk management market size $7.4B in 2025, growing to $8.8B in 2026; cloud deployment leads with 49.79% share
SEC finalizes climate disclosure rules March 6, 2024; LAFs must report quantitative physical risk and financial estimates aligned with TCFD/ISSB framework
Climatic Risk Analytics Market growing at 18.85% CAGR; key players include Clarity AI, MSCI, Verisk Analytics, RMS, Jupiter Intelligence, Cervest, Climate X, One Concern

notes.growth_5y: Based on climate risk management market growth from ~$2.0B in 2021 to $8.8B in 2026. Multiple market research firms confirm the ~$8.8B 2026 figure (GMI, Roots Analysis). 2021 baseline estimated from historical market reports.
notes.growth_1y: Based on CAGR of 32.58% applied to AI-specific climate risk segment, confirmed by GMI forecast data. Total market grew from $7.4B (2025) to $8.8B (2026) = +19% total market; AI-specific segment grows faster at 26-32% per TrendX and GMI.
notes.growth_3m: +62% is [UNVERIFIED] — estimated from acceleration in SEC disclosure procurement cycles (Q2-Q3 2026 peak as companies prepare FY2025 annual report filings). No quarterly market data available.
notes.market_shares: Individual company market share percentages are ESTIMATES based on market positioning described in MarkNtel, Correntics, and GMI reports. No authoritative market share breakdown by company was found in public sources.
notes.competitor_details: Jupiter Intelligence asset count (134,000+) based on platform documentation. ZestyAI $52M funding verified from public filings. Cervest acquisition by Icebreaker One is [UNVERIFIED] — marked as such in main data file.
